name: Gene Ontology cellular component
rationale: Primary identifier; every record so far is a GO CC term. GO is CC BY 4.0 for the ontology files but a CURIE is a reference, not redistributed content. Terms carry PMID-backed definitions and never_in_taxon axioms (GO:0140737 encapsulin nanocompartment, def PMID:32918485). Verify every CURIE against OLS in the script that writes it — three guessed ids reached PR #1.

name: UniProt Subcellular Location
rationale: CC BY 4.0 (subcell.txt footer). 6/6 test structures have an SL term with a 1:1 GO line; cc_scl_term x organism_id returns reviewed member proteins with ECO:0000269 PubMed evidence per localisation. Canary carboxysome x PCC 7942 wrote 8 protein examples and surfaced 5 missing components (#40). No SL term for the ribosome (#42).

name: TraitMech
rationale: Sibling repo, CC0. Trait CURIEs (METPO:, traitmech:) were verified by grep of a local checkout; no automated cross-repo check yet (#11).

name: Wikimedia Commons
rationale: Per-file licence is machine-readable (extmetadata LicenseShortName, SDC P275/P6216); taxon via SDC P180 -> Wikidata P685 but sparse (pass --taxon when absent); publication DOI only in free-text Credit. Hot-linking "not recommended"; descriptive User-Agent required. scripts/fetch_commons_image.py reads licence, attribution and taxon from the API, verifies the sha1, strips tracking parameters and refuses an unmapped licence; all three Commons images in the corpus are reproduced by it. Hosts CC0 / PD / CC BY / CC BY-SA only; anything else is link-only.

name: PubMed Central open access (pmc-oa-opendata S3)
rationale: Uses only the versioned 2026 S3 layout. Metadata must say CC BY/CC0; the exact version comes from a recognized JATS Creative Commons URL and must agree with that family. Media md5 and JATS figure id are exact; taxon is an explicit curator assertion already present on the record; likely multi-panel figures require acknowledgement. Figure-level coverage can be measured without scraping PMC pages; unavailable legacy entries are counted separately.

name: EMDB + EMPIAR
rationale: Records the CC0 EMPIAR raw dataset and only imports the linked EMDB depositor image after resolving an exact EMDB cross-reference and natural_source taxid. EMDB policy requires representative figures without copyright restrictions. Reconstruction resolution stays in notes, never biological physical_properties. Live bacteria keyword cohort: 87/93 have an EMDB bridge; archaea: 4/4.

name: Cell Image Library
rationale: Per-item JSON-LD supplies the CIL DOI, exact licence URL, attribution, primary distribution and a source-hosted preview without an API key. The adapter accepts only Public Domain and exact CC BY 3.0/4.0 terms, confines preview downloads to CIL's media host, and requires a curator-supplied taxon already asserted by the target record. Coverage remains thin: the four verified prokaryote examples do not depict a structure in the current corpus closely enough for a canary mutation.

name: Complex Portal
rationale: Complex Portal data accessed through web services is CC0 (Meldal et al. 2022). Exact CPX accession endpoint only; source taxon must already be on the record. Taxon-specific participants and stoichiometry are stored separately from canonical components, with a required curator scope note and no inferred equivalence xref. CPX-3802/CPX-3807 live canaries added to ribosome.

name: EcoCyc / BioCyc
rationale: Live reassessment corrected the old no-redistribution conclusion: the data-file click-through licence names EcoCyc an Open Database and permits API-derived redistribution for any purpose, but a distributor must first notify SRI and must ship a BioCyc hyperlink, prescribed notice, and BioCyc logo. The anonymous getxml endpoint and CPLX0-7452 remain live. Keep CURATE_ONLY until the owner authorizes the external notification and the site implements the required branding (#110); then an exact-accession adapter can ingest cited E. coli complex composition and stoichiometry.

name: Atlas of Bacterial & Archaeal Cell Structure (CaltechDATA)
rationale: CC BY-NC 4.0 — link-only, never host (test-enforced via the licence enum). >150 cryo-ET tomograms, ~70 species; each video has a CaltechDATA DOI 10.22002/D1.NNNN with isderivedfrom -> ETDB tomogram. No taxids and no primary-literature DOIs on the records. Used link-only on the S-layer record (PR #33).

name: BioImage Archive
rationale: Live reassessment found direct S-BIAD submissions with explicit per-accession CC0/CC BY 4.0 terms and structure-relevant files. The adapter rejects brokered/non-S-BIAD records and all other terms; resolves an exact manifest path and byte count; requires a curator-mapped record taxon; and selects a manifest-named TIFF channel rather than silently taking frame 1. S-BIAD2294 is the canary: its CC0 Figure 3 TIFF names HADA-labelled E. coli peptidoglycan as channel 3, exported losslessly to PNG.

name: SubtiWiki v5
rationale: B. subtilis gene categories and structure/{id}/components work via the Swagger API; no complex stoichiometry; no GO. No licence statement anywhere found (site, JS bundle, Swagger, 2025 NAR paper). BLOCKED until the Stülke lab states terms.

name: ETDB-Caltech
rationale: Unreachable (connection refused) on 2026-08-29; last Wayback 200 capture 2022-12-16; no licence statement found; repos last updated 2018-19. The paper lists NCBItaxID per tomogram but nothing could be exercised. Re-check quarterly; the Atlas/CaltechDATA records are the stable layer.

name: Image Data Resource
rationale: The current study endpoint exposes an exact per-study licence in JSON-LD, and anonymous JSON/search APIs plus single-file FTP downloads work; an adapter could accept only CC0/CC BY 4.0 studies. Rejected for current-corpus gain after live prokaryote review (#112): idr0065 images whole E. coli cells and SeqA-YFP replication foci, idr0091 images whole cells in mother-machine channels and is already mirrored as BioImage Archive S-BIAD852, and idr0127 is macroscopic S. aureus colony growth. None directly depicts an in-scope structure, so there is no defensible canary mutation.

name: MicrO ontology
rationale: CC BY 2.0 static release; still inactive at OBO Foundry and unchanged upstream since 2018. Adopted only for a fixed curator-reviewed identity allow-list (#114), with exact id/label/non-obsolete checks against OLS and no label search: GO:0031411 gas vesicle maps to MICRO:0000214 gas vacuole (exact synonym gas vesicles), and GO:0110143 magnetosome maps to MICRO:0000216. Near matches for flagella and endospores describe qualities or whole cells and are refused.

name: NCI Thesaurus
rationale: 0/6 prokaryotic test structures; organelle branch (C13269) is eukaryote-only; no GO xrefs. CC BY 4.0. Nothing to add.
